summary: Locate the source of nqəlle ruḥe; neither supplied verse matches.
rationale: The cited 95/155 contains nqəlla with two apples thrown at the women’s heads, not nqəlle ruḥe “er stürzte sich auf”. The proposed automatic replacement 95/163 describes digging a pit and hiding in it; its actual verbs include səmlele, čəkle and ṭməlle, and it does not contain the quoted nqr form either. The words and context therefore do not justify changing the reference to 95/163. Check grammar p. 254 or locate the correct textual verse before replacing this reference.

summary: Use the accusative after directional gegen.
rationale: Gegen governs the accusative in this construction; jemandem is the erroneous dative form. This does not change the editors’ tentative lexical interpretation.
